findings.evidence: `grep -n "^+.*change F" diff.txt` → 2472, 2486, 2799, 2874, 2976 — all five are added lines; `grep -n "^-.*change " diff.txt` returns nothing, so none were removed. `Matrix.submatrix_apply` is at mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Defs.lean:480 and is already used at code/TauCeti/Analysis/Bochner/Fourier/Convention.lean:129 and Gaussian/Basic.lean:131 on the same `Matrix.submatrix … a b = …` goal.
findings.fix: Replace each `change` with `rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply]` (plus `BCRPoint.ofProd`/`star`/`add` simp lemmas at Basic.lean:173,184) followed by the substantive rewrite, matching Convention.lean:129; or, if a step is genuinely unreachable that way, add a comment saying so.
findings.issue: Five undocumented `change` steps close the `heq` transports by unfolding `Matrix.submatrix`/`Matrix.of` definitionally: Time/Axis.lean:70, Time/Slice.lean:73, SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:173 and :184-185, Pullback.lean:91. Basic.lean:173 additionally unfolds the `BCRPoint` `star`/`+` instance fields (`(a + star b).point` ⇝ `p.2 + -q.2`). None carries a comment justifying why the goal is unreachable otherwise, and the same PR reaches the identical goal shape via the named lemma at Fourier/Convention.lean:129 and Gaussian/Basic.lean:131.

findings.fix: Use `simp [Matrix.submatrix_apply, …]` / `simpa [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Function.comp_def]` at all three sites.
findings.issue: Three simp calls unfold `Matrix.submatrix` by passing the definition itself to the simp set instead of its API lemma: Pullback.lean:122 `simp [Matrix.submatrix, hw, …]`, Matrix/PosSemidef.lean:129 and :183 `simpa [Matrix.submatrix, Function.comp_def] …`. Same brittleness class as the `change` steps — these break if Mathlib restates `submatrix` even though the statements stay true, and they are inconsistent with the two `Matrix.submatrix_apply` sites in the same PR.

summary: Five undocumented `change` steps added by this PR unfold `Matrix.submatrix`/`Matrix.of` (and the `BCRPoint` star/add instances) by definitional equality, where the named `Matrix.submatrix_apply` — used by this same PR at two other transport sites — applies; three further sites unfold `Matrix.submatrix` as a raw `simp` definition argument. The prior finding about factoring the `heq ▸` transports is withdrawn as adjudicated by the reuse angle.
